description.value:
You unleash a surge of energy in a 15-foot cube centered on yourself. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 ion damage and be shoved 10 feet directly away from you; on a success, a creature takes half damage and is not moved.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 per slot level beyond 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
